data.name: Birth of Nation
data.detailed_description:
After the colonial era ended, new nations rose one after another on the former colonies, and conflicts among various ethnic groups also began to surface. Instigated by ambitious schemers, the exiles suffered massacres and expulsions. To survive, they had no choice but to flee and resist. Can you lead these exiles to build a new nation? How will you carve out living space in the crevice of the Cold War? And when facing battle after battle, can you still win by surprise?

★★★ Triple-Layered Gameplay: Narrative Choices → Resource Management → Tactical Battles ★★★

       Unique triple-layered system: In this interactive cinematic game, you make critical choices. Your decisions reshape both your resource income and the story's direction.

       On the management panel, you turn those resources into industrial chains. Build a haven for the exiled. Through diplomacy and trade, sustain the fragile lifeline of your newborn nation.

       Step by step, resourceful management secures ever-greater advantages for your tactical battles. Then deploy a variety of tactics to win the fight!

★★★ Secure International Support through Diplomacy and Trade ★★★

       From underground resistance in the colonial era to the treacherous currents of the Cold War among great powers, navigating countless perils demands your judgment!

       Under the crippling blockade of hostile nations, you must maneuver and make choices among the major powers, securing diplomatic aid and trade support.

       There are no eternal enemies, but a kind and resilient nation will surely have its friends.

       And of course, the support of various ethnic groups will make your efforts twice as effective.

★★★ 400+ Min Epic Saga · Countless Choices · Lasting Impact ★★★

Will your exiles survive in the bloodtide? Can you hold back the tide of overwhelming invasion?

Can hostile peoples set aside their hatred and unite? How will you keep a new nation from crumbling?

Diplomacy is never easy — but the real question is: can love and friendship bear the brutal weight of politics?

This is not a series of fancy cutscenes between battles.

This is a living, breathing epic — and it's yours to shape.

★★★ Build × Trade × Manufacture —— Lead the Exiled to Build a New Homeland ★★★

They are defenceless — cast out, hunted, with nothing but their will to survive. You are their only hope.

And only you can carve out a sanctuary from the wilderness.

In a land stripped of plenty, you'll solve the problems of balancing resources and supply chains under pressure.

Raise buildings, collect taxes, secure food, power, materials, machinery and forge your weapons to defend.

The cost of war may choke your treasury, but as long as your people stand with you, no mountain is too high to climb.

★★★ Fog-of-War Combat × Rich Battlefield Factors × Authentic Command Experience ★★★

Every combat formation has its own distinct armaments and attack ranges!

Different unit types and formation sizes demand careful consideration!

Players must maneuver stealthily under enemy vision, locate the weakest flank, strike with most effective weapons.

Utilize 16 distinct terrain types! Deploy 4 specialized fortifications, each with its own tactical emphasis!

Master line-of-sight to avoid detection, outflank the enemy, and launch devastating surprise attacks!

Combos! Crits! Extra actions! These interlocking tactical setups will send adrenaline and dopamine surging together!

Even popular support can feed your army critical intel, granting you the upper hand in the fog of war.

★★★ 1,000 + Cinematic Combat Clips — 400 + Unique Battle Outcomes ★★★

Tactics are no longer abstract. Every move is brought to life with stunning visual fidelity.

Combine different units, weapons, and terrain — and see an entirely different cinematic replay for each choice.

Hide your infantry in mountains, rain mortar fire from afar — and watch it all happen before your eyes!

★★★★★★★★★★★★★★★     WE WANT YOU!     ★★★★★★★★★★★★★★★

Defend your home, end the wars, protect those you love!

And carve your name into an epic of Asterhaven that will never bow.

data.short_description: Birth of Nation is an alternate‑history strategy game blending interactive movie gameplay. In cinematic experience players can make choices affecting the plot and resources to manage a refugee nation, engage in diplomacy and trade, and ultimately gather forces for tactical battles against foes.

content_descriptors.notes: This game is a mature political drama set in a wartime and revolutionary context. It contains scenes of violence and bloodshed, including armed conflicts, gunfire, explosions, military casualties, and injuries. Blood appears during combat and death sequences. It also contains mild nudity and sexual content, with brief scenes of partial nudity and implied romantic intimacy between characters, including kissing and embraces. No explicit sexual intercourse is shown. The story deals with sensitive themes including racial persecution, political suppression, refugee crises, domestic abuse, and character deaths. All mature elements are presented within a serious historical‑fiction narrative. Through depicting the brutality of war and conflict, this work seeks to convey the importance of mutual understanding between peoples, and the value of peace and reconciliation.
